name: FreeGEM
description: FreeGEM is an open source version of Digital Research's GEM. GEM is primarily known as the native GUI of the Atari ST series - although it was also available for other systems at that time. It uses a dithered blue as background, the other colors are not actual choices but the two colors making up the dithered background.

colors.name: Dithered Blue (Gamma-Corrected)
colors.note: The same dithered desktop, averaged in linear light and gamma-corrected: a lighter blue. The simpler pixel average is #5454d4.

colors.name: Stone Gray
colors.note: One of the two colors the FreeGEM desktop is dithered from: the gray filling half the checkerboard.

colors.name: Blue
colors.note: One of the two colors the FreeGEM desktop is dithered from: the blue filling the other half of the checkerboard.
